summary: The homepage lists four different things: an equity-free grant while ideating, an investment of up to $250K after a company is formed, follow-on funding of up to $5M, and more than $600K in partner credits. The grant, the investment, and the credits are not one equity package.
formattedTerms:
Equity-free grant to support you while you’re still ideating
Up to $250K investment once you form a company
Up to $5M in follow-on funding through your future rounds — and continued support up to Series B
Over $600K in credits to help you move at warp speed: $350K in Azure credits; $250K+ from OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, PostHog, Datadog, ElevenLabs and more
